Setup

  1. Download AuroraSwitch.bin.
  2. Back up a FAT32 USB drive. Put AuroraSwitch.bin at its root as the only root BIN.
  3. Add supported firmware to aurora/, using the exact filenames in the reference.
  4. Safely eject, insert into Aurora and follow Qu-Bit's USB update procedure.
    Leave AuroraSwitch.bin at the root. Keep USB connected for selection and automatic boot.

Aurora HP-filter variant

Discord download

ReverbsLime

By michael on the QuBit Discord.

Stock Aurora controls with two shifted changes. Add the exact supplied
Aurora_v1-4-6_hpfilt.bin in the USB aurora/ folder.

Shifted controls

Control Function
96 Shift + Atmosphere Dry-input high-pass
93 Shift + Blur Wet level

Other controls follow the stock Aurora reference.

Details & sources

  • RAM launch; no selector QSPI programming for this payload.
  • Changes are described in the supplied community notes. Physical behavior
    remains unverified; this is not an official Aurora release.
